best_lineage.idea: Replace the current merge sort with an LSD radix sort using 8-bit digits (4 passes) and a single counting pass, which will be significantly faster for 32-bit integers on large arrays.

Replace the radix sort with an adaptive hybrid: detect sorted/reverse-sorted runs in O(n) and short-circuit, otherwise fall back to a highly optimized LSD radix sort that computes all four histograms in one pass, skips passes where all keys share the same byte, and uses NEON intrinsics for the histogramming loop to maximize throughput.
